//: Whether this project rebuilds, decided here rather than in the dashboard.
The setting it replaces was inverted: it tested for a path relative to the
repository root while running from this directory, so the test always
passed and Vercel read exit 0 as 'skip'. Every deployment of portalforms
was Cancelled and forms.morganhacks.com never served anything.
git diff --quiet has exactly the exit codes Vercel wants: 0 when nothing
changed, which means skip, and 1 when something did, which means build.
libs is included because both consoles import their palette from it, and a
change there that does not rebuild is a colour that means two things.
On a shallow clone HEAD^ may not resolve. That errors non-zero, which
builds. Failing towards a build is the right way round.
